journey.name: Switch network
journey.description: Changes the active network in Settings to Signet and back, verifying each restart brings the node up on the new network's data dir, RPC port and RPC cookie (the cookie lives in the data dir: files/.cookie on mainnet, files/signet/.cookie on signet), and that mainnet resumes where it left off.

actions.action: Launch the Mandacaru app and wait for the splash screen to dismiss (poll until nav_node is present)
Record the mainnet header height (getblockchaininfo "headers", with the README's RPC recipe on port 8332)
Scroll to the Advanced features switch (toggle_advanced_features) and turn it on if it is off — the Network section only renders while it is on
Expand the Network section if it is collapsed
Tap the SIGNET option in the dropdown (target it by its text)
Verify the app restarts and the Node navigation item (nav_node) is selected once it is back up
Verify node_network reads SIGNET and, within 30 seconds, node_peer_count is above zero
Cross-check on signet: `adb forward tcp:38332 tcp:38332`, then call getblockchaininfo on port 38332 authenticated with files/signet/.cookie; verify "chain" is "signet"
Switch back: in Settings, expand the Network section again (it is collapsed after the restart), tap input_network and choose BITCOIN (by text); wait for the restart and for nav_node
Verify node_network reads BITCOIN and getblockchaininfo on port 8332 (cookie re-read from files/.cookie — it is a new one) reports "headers" at or above the height recorded at the start
